integrity: Analytical proof accompanied by a standalone finite exact witness and exhaustive small-size checker; numerical checks cannot certify arbitrary sizes. No external independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Clamped endpoints; odd symmetric windows; unweighted finite-path total variation; real scalar data; n at least window width plus one. The dated 2015 source is a day-verifiable public manuscript upload of an older 1994 paper, not the claimed original publication date; historical reports precede it but their earliest public release days were not verified. Early literature priority needs external scholarly inspection.
title: Exact rank-dependent variation sensitivity of sliding order-statistic filters
